seoTitle: Fix: Google Workspace Custom Logo Not Showing
metaDescription: Troubleshoot and fix a custom company logo that isn't displaying in Google Workspace, plus how to properly upload and update your branding.
intro: Your company logo is part of how your brand shows up across Gmail and other Workspace apps, so it's frustrating when an upload doesn't take effect. This guide covers common causes of a missing logo and how to fix and update it correctly.

steps.heading: Understand the issue
steps.body: A logo not displaying is usually caused by an incorrect file format, size mismatch, or a delay in Google syncing the change across services.

steps.heading: Check your image requirements
steps.body: Make sure your logo file meets Google's recommended dimensions and format before uploading, since an oversized or unsupported file often fails silently.

steps.heading: Go to the branding settings
steps.body: In the Admin Console, find the company profile or branding section where the custom logo upload option lives.

steps.heading: Upload the corrected logo
steps.body: Replace the existing file with a properly sized image and save the change, then check whether it appears immediately or needs time to propagate.

steps.heading: Confirm the logo displays correctly
steps.body: Check Gmail and other Workspace apps after saving to confirm your new logo is showing up as expected across your organization.

faq.question: Why isn't my custom logo showing up in Google Workspace?
faq.answer: This is often caused by an incorrect image size or format, or simply a delay before the change propagates across all Workspace services.

faq.question: What image format works best for a Google Workspace logo?
faq.answer: Google generally recommends a PNG file within their specified dimension guidelines for the clearest, most consistent display.

faq.question: How long does it take for a new logo to appear?
faq.answer: Once uploaded correctly, it can take anywhere from a few minutes to a few hours to fully appear across all apps and users.

faq.question: Do all users see the same company logo?
faq.answer: Yes, once set by an admin, the custom logo applies organization-wide and appears consistently for all users.
